description: Ministry of City Planning & Water Supply - Order to acquisition of the immovable property at Katubedda Village,Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District and Koswatta, Beliatta D/S Division, Hambanthota District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains two separate orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific immovable properties for water infrastructure projects. The content includes detailed descriptions of land parcels, their boundaries, locations, and the names of property claimants. While it mentions a government minister (Rauff Hakeem) and his ministerial title, the core focus is on land acquisition for specific projects, making it primarily a land-related gazette rather than a government personnel or structural announcement.
